rules.title: Application screening fee cap
rules.quote: In no case shall the amount of the application screening fee charged by the landlord or their agent be greater than thirty dollars ($30) per applicant. The thirty dollar ($30) application screening fee may be adjusted annually by the landlord or their agent commensurate with an increase in the Consumer Price Index, beginning on January 1, 1998.
rules.summary: The application screening fee charged by a landlord or their agent cannot exceed thirty dollars per applicant, subject to annual adjustment for increases in the Consumer Price Index since January 1, 1998.
rules.effective_date_evidence: Amended by Stats. 2025, Ch. 67, Sec. 29.   (AB 1170)   Effective January 1, 2026.

rules.title: Receipt requirement for application screening fees
rules.quote: The landlord or their agent shall provide, personally, or by mail, the applicant with a receipt for the fee paid by the applicant, which receipt shall itemize the out-of-pocket expenses and time spent by the landlord or their agent to obtain and process the information about the applicant.
rules.summary: The landlord or their agent must provide the applicant with a receipt itemizing the out-of-pocket expenses and time spent obtaining and processing information about the applicant.
rules.effective_date_evidence: Amended by Stats. 2025, Ch. 67, Sec. 29.   (AB 1170)   Effective January 1, 2026.

rules.title: Refund of unused screening fees
rules.quote: If the landlord or their agent does not perform a personal reference check or does not obtain a consumer credit report, the landlord or their agent shall return any amount of the screening fee that is not used for the purposes authorized by this section to the applicant.
rules.summary: If the landlord does not perform a personal reference check or obtain a consumer credit report, they must return any unused portion of the screening fee to the applicant.
rules.effective_date_evidence: Amended by Stats. 2025, Ch. 67, Sec. 29.   (AB 1170)   Effective January 1, 2026.

rules.title: Provision of consumer credit report to applicant
rules.quote: If an application screening fee has been paid by the applicant, the landlord or their agent shall provide a copy of the consumer credit report to the applicant who is the subject of that report by personal delivery, mail, or email within seven days of the landlord or their agent receiving the report.
rules.summary: If an application screening fee has been paid, the landlord must provide a copy of the consumer credit report to the applicant within seven days of receiving the report.
rules.effective_date_evidence: Amended by Stats. 2025, Ch. 67, Sec. 29.   (AB 1170)   Effective January 1, 2026.
